subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: What should the local avatar failure contract be for policy-rejected files such as avatars over 2 MB: current 404 plus metadata/settings diagnostics, stronger webchat-visible diagnostics, or a changed size/serving policy?
rationale: The remaining choice affects the security boundary for workspace file serving and the public UX contract for avatar failures, so automation should not silently change the limit or error behavior.

options.title: Preserve limit and improve diagnostics
options.body: Keep the 2 MB local-file guard and workspace containment, but surface `too_large`, `missing`, and unsafe-path reasons clearly in webchat/settings before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Accept the current 404 plus metadata/settings diagnostics as sufficient and close only after the open fork PR is closed or superseded.

options.title: Change the size policy
options.body: Raise or redesign the local avatar size limit, with explicit security review and tests for memory, MIME, auth, and file-containment behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve limit and improve diagnostics
recommendation.body: Keep the 2 MB local-file guard and workspace containment, but surface `too_large`, `missing`, and unsafe-path reasons clearly in webchat/settings before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the original avatar merge and later avatar validation/security hardening that define the decision boundary.
